hero.title: Coverage reports, made readable.
hero.body: Coviz turns an LCOV, JaCoCo, Cobertura or LLVM JSON report into one self-contained HTML page. Browse it locally, attach it to a CI run, or send it to someone. No server, no Node, no extra files.

preview.dirLabel: Preview of a generated report, directory view
preview.fileLabel: Preview of a generated report, file view

formats.title: Reads what your toolchain already writes
formats.body: Pass the file and Coviz works out the format from its name or contents. Use --format when the guess needs help.

tools.lcov: gcov, cargo-llvm-cov, c8, Istanbul, Jest, Vitest.
tools.jacoco: Java and Kotlin via Gradle or Maven.
tools.llvm: Clang and Rust, including MC/DC conditions.

output.title: One HTML file you can actually send
output.body: The report is a single page with sources, data and UI inlined. It opens offline, survives being zipped into a CI artifact, and looks the same on the reviewer's machine as on yours.

open.title: Straight to the browser
open.body: Writes a temp file and opens it, for the quick look after a test run.

artifact.title: Keep it as an artifact
artifact.body: Upload it from CI next to your test results. No hosting needed.

link.title: Every file has a link
link.body: Directories and files have their own URL, so you can point at the exact gap you mean.

install.title: A single binary, nothing else
install.body: Prebuilt for Linux (x86-64 and ARM64), macOS (Apple silicon) and Windows (x86-64) on GitHub releases, or installed with Cargo. Other platforms build from source with stable Rust 1.100 or newer.
